summary: Popover.Panel takes variant="content" | "list" (issue #55). content is the default and unchanged. list is a picker on Menu's surface: 280px wide, radius-md, bg-surface, hairline, shadow-md, and no padding of its own. It comes with four new parts. Popover.Search is a bare input on a 36px row under a hairline, and takes initial focus. Popover.List is p-xs, scrolls, and maxRows caps it. Popover.Row is Menu's item recipe made dense: px-sm py-xs on a 32px floor, so every label and glyph sits on a 12px lane. Popover.Footer is p-xs under a top hairline. It is still a dialog; the rows' keyboard model, filtering and selection are the caller's.
